description: This PHP file defines the EmergencyContact DTO class used within the OrangeHRM project to retrieve and normalize emergency contact information for employees. It includes methods for converting the data to an array and mapping fields to employee contact attributes.

classes.name: EmergencyContact
classes.description: Data Transfer Object for handling employee emergency contact data, capable of normalizing and converting emergency contact info into array form.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the EmergencyContact DTO with an employee number.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns a normalized array of emergency contacts for the specified employee.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Provides a mapping from field identifiers to their respective getter methods on Employee or EmergencyContact entities.
